issues: Document is a table rendered sideways (landscape table on portrait page); pages were re-rendered at rotation+90 to read upright, no illegible content otherwise. No explicit ТР ТС / раздел section-heading rows exist anywhere in this document (ТР ТС references only appear as regular cell content in the 'requirements/technical regulation documents' column, not as full-width headings), so tr_section is null on every row per the rules. That 'documents establishing requirements to the object (technical regulations)' column (col.8) is present in this PDF but has no dedicated field in the schema; its content (recurring TR TS / GOST references per product group, spanning merged multi-row cells) was captured only where tied to a single specific row and is otherwise omitted from the JSON (visible in source images). Non-indicator 'header' rows with no norm_doc/range (numbered object rows themselves, and category dividers such as 'Физико-химические показатели:', 'Микробиологические показатели:', 'Пестициды:') were not emitted as JSON rows since they carry no indicator/range data; their object/OKPD2/TNVED codes were propagated to the indicator rows beneath them instead. Several cells contain multiple range bands for a single indicator with no printed criterion distinguishing which band applies to which sub-product (Титруемая кислотность, Массовая доля сухого вещества (group 1), Диастазное число, Гидроксиметилфурфураль (group 3)); these were kept as a single row with the full raw multi-value text in range_from rather than being split or parsed numerically. Row 'Приготовление разведений' (group 5, ГОСТ Р 51426-99) falls right at the page 6/7 break; its range value is not visible in the rendered images (page 7 resumes at the next row, 'Бактерии рода Salmonella'), so range_from/to/unit were left null for it rather than guessed.
